board.note: tile x 0..17 left->right, depth 0..8 front->back (Godot: position = Vector3(x, 0, -depth)); the ground FBX 'Camp Ground' has its origin at its centre: place it at Vector3(8.5, 0, -4.0)
board.yaw_note: face_yaw / yaw: degrees about the up axis, positive = counter-clockwise seen from above (Godot rotation_degrees.y). face_yaw turns a station prop halfway toward the campfire so it still shows its front to the camera.

slots.note: free slot for a future station
free slot for a future station

decor.note: back-left corner, behind the arc, clear of every slot
back-right corner, behind the arc, clear of every slot

spacing.rule: keep station props on the arc slots; centres >= 3.2 tiles apart (about 2 tiles of clear ground between ~1.2-tile props)
spacing.more_stations: use the free end slots 0 and 6 first; after that add a second, outer arc (a+2, b+1.5) and widen the board by 4 tiles, or move decor
